results.name: actor_get_look_or_aim_position
results.evidence: Gated on type-table DAT_00655258[actor_type*0x38]==4 and perception count field+0x268>8; copies cached aim vector (+0x180..+0x188) when flag+0x6a0 is set, else the look-at vector (+0x63c..+0x644) when short+0x60c>0.
results.summary: Writes the actor's currently valid aim or look-at target position into the caller's output vector and reports success.

results.name: actor_is_vehicle_board_deadline_passed
results.evidence: Only proceeds for mode(+0x6c)==10 (vehicle) with sub-state(+0xa0)==3 and flag(+0xa7) set, then compares stored tick(+0xac)+0x1e to the current tick DAT_006f1d6c+0xc.
results.summary: Returns whether a vehicle-boarding actor's stored deadline (tick+30) has elapsed.

results.name: actor_has_active_weapon_threat
results.evidence: Calls actor_get_threat_weapon_object_index and clears the result when the actor's controlled unit has bit0 of object+0x107 set.
results.summary: Reports whether the actor has an active weapon threat, suppressed when its unit carries the 0x107 bit-0 flag.

results.name: actor_get_tracked_object_index
results.evidence: Resolves actor+0x270 as an index into the 0x138-stride DAT_008802c0 recognized-object table and returns that record's +0x18 (referenced-object index) field, or -1.
results.summary: Returns the object index referenced by the actor's currently tracked recognized-object record, or -1 if none.

results.name: actor_report_tracked_object
results.evidence: Performs the same DAT_008802c0 lookup as actor_get_tracked_object_index via actor+0x270 and forwards its +0x18 field together with param_1 into FUN_0041f7d0.
results.summary: Forwards the actor's tracked target object index to an unidentified helper routine.

results.name: actor_clear_target_on_mode_change
results.evidence: Resets field+0x3b8 to 0xffff; when mode(+0x46c) is 3 or 4 also clears +0x46c and sets +0x480 to -1; then invokes actor-type callback table DAT_00655278[type*0x38].
results.summary: Clears the actor's cached target and, when in modes 3/4, its secondary state, then dispatches the actor-type 'target cleared' callback.

results.name: actor_invalidate_target_caches
results.evidence: Resets fields 0x144/0x148/0x164/0x324, conditionally 0x410 and 0x47c, and 0x494, then for each swarm sub-actor (0x98-stride table via +0x28) clears field+0x10, before invoking actor-type callback DAT_0065527c.
results.summary: Invalidates all cached target/threat references for an actor and its swarm members, then calls the actor-type 'targets invalidated' callback.

results.name: actor_compute_look_direction
results.evidence: Selects between a computed target-relative vector (0x488/0x48c/0x490 minus unit position 0x300/0x130/0x134) and a fixed override vector (0x518-0x520) based on flags 0x504/0x4a8, normalizes it with vector3d_normalize_with_length, and returns whether it is non-zero.
results.summary: Computes and normalizes the actor's desired look/aim direction and reports whether a valid direction exists.

results.name: actor_squad_accumulate_awareness
results.evidence: Resolves a recognized-object record via FUN_0043eb30(param_1,1,1), clears +0x6c, sets +0x74=1, adds param_2 to float +0x70, and propagates the same update to a linked record at +0xc before calling FUN_00422270.
results.summary: Accumulates an awareness/alert score (param_2) onto a recognized-object record and its linked sibling record, then notifies via FUN_00422270.

results.name: actor_disable_and_maybe_delete
results.evidence: Sets bit 0x20 or 0x40 on the referenced unit object's byte+0x106 (single actor, or per swarm-member via +0x1fc chain), then unless param_2 suppresses it, unlinks (actor_unlink_unit / actor_remove_from_unit_cluster) and deletes the actor(s) via actor_delete(1), forwarding the recorded zone index (+0x34) to FUN_00437940.
results.summary: Marks an actor's controlled unit(s) with a shutdown flag and, unless suppressed, unlinks and deletes the actor (and its swarm members).

results.name: actor_release_from_cluster_and_delete
results.evidence: Calls actor_remove_from_unit_cluster(param_1), then if actor field+0x1e==0 (no remaining references) deletes the actor via actor_delete(1) and forwards its zone index (+0x34) to FUN_00437940.
results.summary: Removes an actor from its unit cluster and, once its reference count reaches zero, deletes the actor and notifies its owning zone.

results.name: actor_reset_perception_state
results.evidence: Zeroes a 64-byte local scratch block, seeds it with a constant vector from PTR_DAT_00696714 and fixed 0xffff sentinels, calls FUN_00569720, then copies unit fields (+0x23c..+0x268) into more locals before calling FUN_005639f0(-1) and FUN_00569bf0.
results.summary: Rebuilds a single actor's perception scratch record from constants and current unit state, resetting related perception subsystems.

results.name: actor_reset_perception_dispatch
results.evidence: For a solo actor (byte+6==0) calls FUN_00428f40 once and sets flag+7=1; for a swarm actor it loops the swarm's member count (0x98-stride table via +0x28) calling FUN_00428f40 per member before setting flag+7=1.
results.summary: Dispatches actor_reset_perception_state across a solo actor or every member of a swarm actor, then marks perception as initialized.

results.name: actor_notify_mode_change
results.evidence: Calls actor_clear_target_on_mode_change, then based on flag byte+9 either removes the actor from its squad (squad_remove_actor) or calls FUN_00436990, and finally dispatches to FUN_00436940 or FUN_00436770 depending on register unaff_EBX.
results.summary: Handles an actor mode-change notification by clearing its target and updating its squad/cluster membership accordingly.

results.name: actor_update_boredom_counter
results.evidence: Increments actor+0x4a by 1, or by 3 when in a vehicle-boarding sub-state (mode 0x6c==10, substate 0xa0 in 2..5), compares it to a per-difficulty threshold at DAT_00880354, and resets it with a latch flag(+3) when exceeded, else tracks the running maximum.
results.summary: Increments and thresholds an actor's boredom/idle counter each tick, latching a global 'boredom triggered' flag when it crosses the difficulty threshold.

results.name: actor_get_accuracy_scale
results.evidence: Defaults to 0.5, overridden by a per-player difficulty accuracy value (object+900) when the actor tracks a unit, overridden again to a fixed field(+0xf4) for mode 0xb with flag+0xf0, forced to 0.7 for mode 9, and clamped to a minimum of 0.2.
results.summary: Computes the actor's current weapon-accuracy scale from difficulty settings, special-mode overrides, and a 0.2 floor.

results.name: actor_capture_facing_and_root_position
results.evidence: Copies unit position (+0x74-0x7c) and a node-local transform (via object_get_node_local_transform) into the output struct, then walks the unit's parent chain (+0x11c) to the root object and copies its +0x98/+0x9c fields.
results.summary: Captures an actor unit's current position/orientation plus its root parent object's node data into a caller-supplied output record.

results.name: ai_broadcast_communication_to_actors
results.evidence: Optionally builds a local communication-event record (guarded by DAT_00880354+1), then iterates actor_iterator_next over actors with mode(+0x6e)<7, calling actor_get_firing_positions and FUN_0041c030, and dispatching to FUN_00422780/FUN_00422930/FUN_00422c00 based on param_2.
results.summary: Broadcasts a communication event to every eligible active actor, dispatching one of three delivery paths selected by param_2.

results.name: actor_squad_dispatch_order
results.evidence: Switches on an order record's type field (+0x14: 2/3/4), calling FUN_004221f0 for type 2, FUN_0041f7d0 (guarded by datum_get on the recognized-object table DAT_008802c0) for type 3, or FUN_004233d0 for type 4.
results.summary: Dispatches a squad order record to one of three handlers based on its order-type field.

results.name: actor_set_dirty_flag
results.evidence: Unconditionally ORs bit 0x2 into the actor's status-flags field at +0x6d0.
results.summary: Sets bit 0x2 in the actor's status-flags word.

results.name: actor_set_override_target
results.evidence: Sets or clears bit 0x800 of actor+0x6d0 depending on param_1, and always stores param_2 into +0x720.
results.summary: Sets or clears the actor's target-override flag and updates the associated override value.

results.name: actor_apply_pending_look_and_damage
results.evidence: Gated on the tracked unit lacking a vehicle-seat reference (+0x218) or a global debug flag (DAT_0087a478+0x11); releases a held item via FUN_00569bf0 if flag+7 is set, calls FUN_005639f0(-1), applies a pending look-at via FUN_00569530 when +0x6ec!=-1, and forwards a pending damage record (+0x6d4/+0x6d8) into the unit object.
results.summary: Applies an actor's queued look-at target and pending damage to its controlled unit once it is no longer occupying a vehicle seat.

results.name: ai_globals_tick
results.evidence: Top-level gate on DAT_00880354[1] ('AI active'); calls ai_process_vehicle_entry_queue, then when active[0] runs the main update chain (FUN_00430a70, FUN_00435e00, ai_release_actors_and_swarms) and latches active[2], otherwise calls ai_reset_all_actors_perception once when active[2] was set.
results.summary: Per-tick top-level AI dispatcher that processes vehicle boarding, runs the main actor update chain while AI is active, and resets perception state once AI is deactivated.

results.name: ai_difficulty_get_scalar
results.evidence: Switches on request code (1-4) returning fixed difficulty-table lookups via FUN_0046fe10(0x1c/0x1d/0x1e) for the general/case-1/case-2 paths, or fixed boolean pairs for cases 3 and 4.
results.summary: Returns a difficulty-tuned scalar or boolean pair selected by a small request-code enum.

results.name: ai_zone_bias_random_step
results.evidence: Reads a per-zone bias value from a 0x6c-stride table (DAT_008802c8) indexed by actor+zone offset, nudges it with a signed random step from the DAT_00719cd0 LCG compared against a clamped threshold, and accumulates the delta into both the per-zone and global bias totals.
results.summary: Randomly nudges a per-zone AI difficulty/aggression bias value each call, clamped against a running average, and updates the global total.

results.name: actor_apply_zone_hearing_scale
results.evidence: Scales the caller-supplied float (EDX) by a per-actor hearing field (+0x69c) when a zone flag byte (param_1+4, bit3) is set, or by a fixed 0.3 when actor field +0x1ca is non-zero.
results.summary: Applies a zone- or actor-specific hearing-range scale factor to a caller-supplied distance value.

results.name: ai_release_actors_by_criteria
results.evidence: When AI is active and no filter unit is given (in_EAX==-1), releases every actor via actor_delete_or_release_unit; otherwise walks the actor list from FUN_004369f0 filtering by team(+0x3c) and zone(+0x3a) before releasing matches.
results.summary: Releases all actors, or only those matching a given team/zone filter, back to their controlled units.

results.name: actor_init_grenade_avoid_timer
results.evidence: Captures a random jitter via FUN_0055a2e0 and stores it with a caller id (param_1), a register-supplied id (unaff_EDI), and a fixed 0.15-second deadline into a caller-referenced record.
results.summary: Initializes a grenade-avoidance timer record with a randomized jitter value and a 0.15-second deadline.

results.name: actor_grenade_path_blocked
results.evidence: Iterates the candidate list built by actor_gather_nearby_grenade_targets, testing each (other than param_1) with segment3d_within_radius_of_segment or ray_intersects_sphere_test depending on a per-candidate flag, and outputs the blocking candidate's id through param_3.
results.summary: Checks whether a grenade throw/path toward param_2 is blocked by any nearby friendly/enemy actor, returning the blocking actor's id.

results.name: actor_can_reach_or_see_target
results.evidence: Gates on FUN_0053eb60 (zone connectivity) when both indices are valid, builds a pathfinding/LOS query flag word from param_2/param_4, calls FUN_00505880 for a path/LOS result, and classifies the outcome into 0-4 using distance and coverage thresholds against FUN_00401a20 line checks.
results.summary: Evaluates whether an actor can reach or see a target zone/point, returning a graded reachability/visibility result code (0-4).

results.name: actor_grenade_trajectory_is_clear
results.evidence: Simulates a parabolic trajectory (param_2 as gravity) in 6-unit time steps up to param_1, testing each segment with FUN_00505880 (LOS/path) and against nearby-target candidates via segment3d_within_radius_of_segment, returning failure as soon as any step is blocked or hits a target.
results.summary: Simulates a thrown grenade's parabolic path in steps, returning whether the entire trajectory is clear of obstacles and nearby actors.

results.name: actor_flag_vehicle_boarding_target
results.evidence: Only proceeds if the referenced unit has a valid vehicle-seat reference (+0x218), then calls FUN_0045bd50 and, on failure, optionally sets actor byte +0x2ed=1 when param_1 is set.
results.summary: Attempts to assign the actor to a vehicle boarding action, optionally flagging the actor when the attempt fails.

results.name: actor_update_vehicle_seat_assignment
results.evidence: Resolves a vehicle object via object_try_and_get(3) and its assigned seats (+0x328 driver / +0x324 passenger) to pick a desired seat id, calls FUN_0045bd50 when the current seat differs, then broadcasts ai_communication_broadcast(0), clears squad unit references, and calls FUN_00435f90.
results.summary: Determines and applies the actor's desired vehicle seat assignment, then notifies its squad of the seat change.

results.name: ai_communication_mark_team_recognized_objects
results.evidence: Iterates actors via actor_iterator_next filtering on team field +0x3e against param_1/param_2, then walks each matching actor's recognized-object list (0x138-stride, chained via +8) setting flags +0x60/+0x61/+0x62/+0xa4 and rescoring via actor_rate_potential_target for entries whose target-team (+0x12) matches.
results.summary: Marks and rescores every recognized-object entry belonging to actors on the given team pair, flagging them as newly noticed.

results.name: actor_recompute_all_perceived_relationships
results.evidence: Iterates every actor and every recognized-object entry (0x138-stride chained via +0x50/+8), recomputing the target's team field(+0x12) from the object header, its hostility flag(+0x60/+0x61) from a team-relationship bitmask (DAT_006b0b84) or team-equality when DAT_006f1d20 is set, and rescoring each entry via actor_rate_potential_target.
results.summary: Recomputes every actor's perceived hostility and target rating for each of its recognized objects, each tick.

results.name: unit_react_squads_to_grenade_threat
results.evidence: Resolves a unit via object_try_and_get(3) and its target field (+0x324/+0x328); for a biped-type unit resolves the thrower's and the target's current-weapon(offset 500) squads via FUN_0043eb30 and calls actor_squad_react_to_grenade for each.
results.summary: Notifies the squads of both a unit and its perceived target to react to a thrown grenade.

results.name: ai_communication_react_to_damage
results.evidence: Resolves a target unit via object_try_and_get(3), classifies the relationship (self/friend/foe via FUN_0045bd50) versus the damage source, forwards non-melee damage to actor_squad_accumulate_awareness (FUN_00428840), and dispatches an ai_communication_broadcast event (pain/damage-taken) selected by relationship and damage amount.
results.summary: Reacts to an actor taking damage by updating squad awareness and broadcasting an appropriate pain/threat communication event.

results.name: ai_handle_object_deleted
results.evidence: Guarded by the AI-active flag and the deleted object's type bitmask (biped/vehicle); releases or deletes any actor controlling the object, walks the recognized-object datum table (data_iterator_next) clearing/removing entries referencing it, clears squad unit references, and removes it from the global memory-of-dead-object array (+0x8b8/+0x8bc).
results.summary: Cleans up all AI state (actors, recognized-object records, squad references) that referenced an object which has just been deleted.

results.name: unit_propagate_perception_timestamp_to_passengers
results.evidence: Updates a unit's last-seen fields (+0x21c/+0x220) from register-passed time/threshold values when stale, then for a vehicle-type unit (+0xb4==1) walks its passenger chain (+0x118/+0x114) alerting each biped passenger via ai_alert_actors_in_grenade_radius.
results.summary: Refreshes a unit's perception timestamp and, for a vehicle, propagates a grenade-alert to each of its biped passengers.

results.name: unit_trigger_weapon_dialogue_once
results.evidence: Resolves the current weapon object (offset +500) of a register-passed unit's controlling actor, and if the actor's +0x38c one-shot flag is clear, triggers ai_communication_broadcast(0x25) then always clears the flag.
results.summary: Plays a one-shot weapon-related dialogue line for an actor the first time this is called after the flag is set.

results.name: ai_query_recent_combat_activity
results.evidence: Iterates the recognized-object datum table (data_iterator_next) for entries with an active target (+0x218!=-1), classifying combat recency using flags at +0x17c/bit 0x80000, distance +0x11c, and time fields (+0x8c, game tick DAT_006f1d6c+0xc), returning true as soon as a qualifying recent-combat record is found.
results.summary: Scans all recognized-object records for any actor recently or currently engaged in combat, returning true on the first match.

results.name: ai_communication_accumulate_event_position
results.evidence: Maintains a 32-entry ring buffer in ai_globals (+0x130/+0x132 head/tail, +0x134 array of {id,count,position,timestamp} records) keyed by param_3, merging new positions into matching recent entries or evicting stale ones (older than 0x78 ticks), then forwards accumulated events to FUN_00429fc0.
results.summary: Accumulates repeated communication-event positions into a rolling per-type buffer and forwards merged events for broadcast.

results.name: ai_squad_reevaluate_combat_state
results.evidence: Iterates the 0x6c-stride squad/zone table (DAT_008802c8), checking each active squad's members for ongoing combat via team-hostility bitmask (DAT_006b0b84) and recognized-object distance/timeout, and either regroups stragglers into a new actor cluster (actor_new_and_attach_to_unit) or deactivates the squad (squad_deactivate) when no members remain in combat; also clears leftover recognized-object entries for freshly-deleted actors. Zero callers; confirmed via full pack.py read.
results.summary: Per-squad tick that re-evaluates whether each squad is still in active combat, regrouping isolated members or deactivating squads that are no longer engaged.

results.name: ai_reset_communication_and_squad_state
results.evidence: Sets the communication-enabled flag (DAT_00880354+0x10), clears the per-category last-spoken-time arrays (+0x14..+0x28), resets both conversation timestamp tables (DAT_006f0c98/9c, DAT_006f0ca0/a4) to -1, zeroes a 0x40-dword conversation-state block, and re-initializes a global communication record (DAT_008802d4) including a 2-char name copy via _strncpy.
results.summary: Resets all mission-level AI communication and conversation-cooldown state at the start of a level or encounter.

results.name: ai_reference_record_clear
results.evidence: Zeroes an 8-dword buffer pointed to by in_EAX and then stamps sentinel values (0xffffffff/0xffff) into its first three fields.
results.summary: Clears and re-initializes a small 32-byte reference record to its empty/sentinel state.

results.name: ai_communication_notify_if_needed
results.evidence: Switches on a register-passed event id (in_CX); for a small excluded set (0,1,2,7,10) does nothing, otherwise calls ai_communication_record_line_played only if a flag at in_EDX+10 is clear.
results.summary: Records that a communication line was played for most event types, unless the type is in a small excluded set or already recorded.

results.name: ai_communication_propagate_to_nearby_actors
results.evidence: For an event record whose kind field (+0x14) is 1, first calls ai_communication_mark_team_recognized_objects; then obtains the source position via object_get_node_local_transform (following a parent chain via object_get_root_object_index), and for every other actor within 900 (30^2) units on the same/opposing team resolves a recognized-object entry (FUN_0043eb30) and, if it has firing positions, dispatches to actor_get_firing_positions/FUN_0041c030/FUN_0042a540/FUN_0042f840.
results.summary: Propagates a combat/communication event from its source position to every nearby actor on a related team, updating their recognized-object state.

results.name: ai_communication_find_order_target
results.evidence: Scans the DAT_00656b08 order/communication table for entries matching param_3/param_4, applies a random-chance gate (DAT_00719cd0 PRNG vs per-entry probability) and a game-time gate (DAT_00725204), resolves a target object via FUN_004300d0/object_try_and_get depending on entry type, and computes a recency-based weight into param_5.
results.summary: Finds a suitable order/target for a communication trigger by scanning a scripted order table under time and probability gates.

results.name: ai_communication_try_play_line
results.evidence: Walks the chain of DAT_00656b08 entries sharing param_2's id, resolves a target object (via FUN_0042ff80/FUN_004300d0/object_try_and_get depending on entry type), checks it isn't already engaged (target+0x218==-1) and passes a probability/callback gate, then queues the line via FUN_00560d00/FUN_00560f20, records it played (ai_communication_record_line_played), and issues a follow-up order (FUN_004302e0). Confirmed via full pack.py read.
results.summary: Attempts to select an eligible target and play a specific scripted communication line, then records it played and issues a matching order.

results.name: actor_update_grenade_eligibility_cache
results.evidence: Computes whether the actor is in grenade-throw state 3 with a low grenade-cooldown counter (+0x72 < +0x6e), caches the boolean at +0x6cc, and stores a fresh random re-check delay (via random_seed_global) at +0x6ce.
results.summary: Recomputes and caches whether the actor is currently eligible to be warned about an incoming grenade, with a randomized re-check interval.

results.name: actor_update_grenade_warning_timer
results.evidence: Refreshes the grenade-eligibility cache (actor_update_grenade_eligibility_cache) when its cached state is stale or has changed, decrements the countdown at +0x6ce, and on reaching zero queues a grenade-warning line via FUN_00560d00/FUN_00560f20.
results.summary: Ticks down the actor's grenade-warning cooldown and, when it expires, queues a grenade-reaction communication line.

results.name: actor_check_nearby_recognized_unit_class
results.evidence: Resolves param_3 (a unit index) to its recognized-object entry via FUN_0043eb30, then checks the entry's distance field (+0x11c<5.0) and category field (+0x38 in {0,1}).
results.summary: Checks whether a given unit is a nearby (within 5 units) recognized object of category 0 or 1.

results.name: ai_communication_dispatch_order
results.evidence: Reads a small record via register (in_ECX) with a target-count/type at +0xe, forwards single-target orders (with a self-target check against the caller's recognized-object field +0x18) to FUN_004302e0, or multi-target orders to FUN_004303a0.
results.summary: Dispatches a queued communication order to either the single-target or multi-target order handler.

results.name: ai_communication_get_line_volume
results.evidence: Calls FUN_00560d00 to fetch a queued line's type/time; halves the caller-supplied volume (*0.3) for type-1 lines, then when requested fades the volume to zero based on elapsed time since the line started (game tick DAT_006f1d6c+0xc).
results.summary: Computes the current playback volume of a queued communication line, applying type-based attenuation and an elapsed-time fade-out.

results.name: object_get_communication_class
results.evidence: Looks up the object's type via its type-flags table (PTR_PTR_006853b8) and tests bits 2/4 of the type-flags field, returning 0, 1, or -1.
results.summary: Classifies an object's type for communication purposes as 0, 1, or -1 (not applicable) based on its type-flags bitmask.

results.name: ai_communication_score_actor_for_line
results.evidence: Combines distance checks against caller-supplied positions, a random cooldown gate via FUN_004303f0, team/self exclusion bitmask param_10, line-of-sight/proximity checks against both a source and destination actor's recognized-object records, and a fatigue check FUN_00569470, returning a float10 score (or 0.0 when disqualified). Confirmed via full pack.py read.
results.summary: Scores how suitable a given actor is to speak a particular communication line, combining distance, relationship, and eligibility checks.

results.name: ai_communication_choose_best_actor_in_squad
results.evidence: Enumerates a squad's actors via FUN_00432650/FUN_004326d0, scoring each with ai_communication_score_actor_for_line, and returns the highest-scoring actor index.
results.summary: Picks the best-scoring squad member to speak a given communication line.

results.name: ai_communication_choose_best_actor_by_team
results.evidence: Iterates the global actor list via actor_iterator_next filtering by team relative to param_1 (same/different/either), scoring each candidate with ai_communication_score_actor_for_line and returning the highest-scoring actor's controlled-unit reference.
results.summary: Finds the best-scoring actor on a given team (or opposing/any team) to speak a communication line.

results.name: ai_communication_issue_order_to_unit
results.evidence: Resolves a target unit via object_try_and_get(3) or a register-passed unit index, checks its recognized-object category (+0x24 in [2,3]) via FUN_0043ea80, and forwards either a direct-unit or best-match order record to FUN_004142d0.
results.summary: Issues a scripted communication order aimed at a specific unit, or the best matching recognized unit, via the order dispatcher.

results.name: ai_communication_issue_simple_order
results.evidence: Validates register-passed context and an object lookup (object_try_and_get(-1)) before forwarding param_1 with no extra target data to FUN_004142d0.
results.summary: Issues a simple, untargeted communication order via the order dispatcher.
